scope: server-side artwork and song-analysis request class

services.database: AppSync: select ImagePath from undeleted djmdContent by ID, then undeleted djmdPlaylist by ID; Master fallback: resolve djmdImage path by image ID
services.filesystem: JPEG file, at most 1 MiB, accepted by CheckImgSize_XYE
services.response: 4002 binary reply; failures also emit an empty 4002 after an error
notes: track type 1 calls the database interface
track types 3 and 4 return image error 1
track type 2 and other non-1 types return image error 2
services.name: CMD_GET_IMAGE

services.database: AppSync: thin call to the same ImagePath lookup using content ID; Master fallback: DsqlContent_GetImageID then djmdImage path
services.response: 4002 binary reply; failures also emit an empty 4002 after an error
notes: only track type 1 is accepted; every other type returns image error 3
services.name: CMD_GET_IMAGE2

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.filesystem: sequential DAT PWAV/PWV2 readers in MstLoadLoudWave/MstLoadDotWave
services.response: fixed 904-byte payload: 800-byte loud preview plus 100-byte dot preview and framing
notes: wire header declares five tags although the final zero-length blob is omitted
services.name: CMD_GET_WAVEDATA

services.database: AppSync cue callback or undeleted djmdCue rows filtered by ContentID
services.response: legacy fixed-width cue/loop blob with counts and auxiliary blob
services.name: CMD_GET_USB_CUE

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.filesystem: DAT PQTZ through MstLoadBeatGrid and MstLoadBeatGridWithHeader
services.response: 20-byte header plus 16 bytes per beat; more than 6,248 beats is rejected
services.name: CMD_GET_QUANTIZE_DATA

services.response: logs the request and returns internal -2 without a payload builder
notes: only the packed context track-type byte is read
services.name: conformance-only malformed/guessed request

services.response: logs the request and returns internal -2 without a payload builder
notes: only the packed context track-type byte is read
services.name: CMD_GET_DISC_CUE

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.response: fixed 1,604-byte binary payload; failure emits an empty 4502
services.name: CMD_GET_VBR_INFO

services.response: logs the request and returns internal -2 without a payload builder
notes: only the packed context track-type byte is read
services.name: CMD_INFO_DISC_EJECT

services.response: logs the request and returns internal -2 without a payload builder
notes: only the packed context track-type byte is read
services.name: CMD_ASK_DISCID_REGSTAT

services.response: single four-byte quantize value rather than the beat-grid blob
services.name: CMD_GET_QTZ_OFFSET

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.filesystem: replace the analysis filename with its EXT sibling, then scan for PWV3
services.response: 20-byte header plus one packed height/color byte per 1/150-second segment
services.name: CMD_GET_PAR_WAVE

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.filesystem: replace the analysis filename with its EXT sibling, then scan for PKEY
services.response: 24-byte header plus 12 bytes per segmented-key entry
services.name: CMD_GET_KEY_INFO

services.database: AppSync callback or djmdCue plus cue-option lookups by ContentID
services.response: variable-width extended cue records and entry count
notes: a separate shared-content builder exists for callback-owned cue data
services.name: CMD_GET_USB_CUE2

services.database: database-interface +0x180 analysis-path lookup by content ID
services.filesystem: replace analysis extension with uppercased EXT or 2EX, then MstLoadAtomInfo
services.response: concatenated length-prefixed matching atoms plus trailing numeric zero
notes: extensions other than EXT and 2EX return an empty 4f02
PCP2, PCPT, and PMAI are explicitly short-circuited to an empty 4f02
all other atom tags reach MstLoadAtomInfo
services.name: CMD_GET_SPECIFIED_ATOM_INFO

services.response: exact handler alias of 2c04 with the original request kind echoed
notes: extensions other than EXT and 2EX return an empty 4f02
PCP2, PCPT, and PMAI are explicitly short-circuited to an empty 4f02
all other atom tags reach MstLoadAtomInfo
services.name: CMD_GET_SPECIFIED_ATOM_INFO2
